Fun film which trumps major breakthroughs in public transport that would make the transport of people go more smoothly. According to this film, that would be the introduction of automatic ticket gates at train stations, and more rapid transit options. Fun to see this all developing.. It did turn out to be a good idea, though I'm pretty sure that barely made a dent in the car population though.

Let's get end traffic congestion by getting people out of cars and onto transit. Yes, kiddies, they were saying this in the late '60s, as this film from Litton Industries shows (the rush hour goes right past a Litton plant). It hasn't quite happened, has it? A pedestrian runs in front of a car that's already turned and is half-way through a cross-walk. Things never change. The film also shows brand-new methods of automatic fare collection, with ticket-reading computerised turnstiles.
